Small experiment files for the protocol tests (CPU, `bench run --dev`), on the nova-bf
fixtures (tests/fixtures/novabf, made by its make_fixtures.py; data paths are relative to the
clean_benchmarks root, the legs' cwd). The nova-bf configs mirror experiments/novabf/*.yaml
(same ${NOVABF_*} variables, params verbatim) except k and the CPU multivector kernel.
